pages.text: Hunt for $(bold)29 custom enchantments$() beyond the $(thing)Apotheosis$() and vanilla pools: 24 general-purpose ones from enchanting and loot, plus 5 planetary ones that only Ad Astra planet mobs drop.$(br2)All of them are real enchantments and work with every Apotheosis system.

pages.title: Dimensional Survival
pages.text: $(bold)Heatward$(): Fire/lava resistance, scaling with level$(br)$(bold)Voidward$(): Void damage reduction$(br)$(bold)Depthstrider$(): Pressure/depth damage resistance$(br)$(bold)Aether Acclimation$(): Thin-air resistance high in the Aether (Tier 4)$(br)$(bold)Warp Shield$(): Teleportation effect resistance$(br2)$(italic)You need these for $(t3)Tier 3$()+ dimensional content.$()

pages.title: Resource & Combat
pages.text: $(bold)Prospector$(): Passive ore detection$(br)$(bold)Lumberjack$(): Tree-felling area$(br)$(bold)Reaping$(): Replants on harvest$(br2)$(bold)Momentum$(): Damage scales with movement speed$(br)$(bold)Adrenaline$(): Low-HP damage boost$(br)$(bold)Titan Slayer$(): Bonus damage to large/boss mobs$(br)$(bold)Crowd Control$(): AoE slow/weaken on hit$(br)$(bold)Adaptive$(): Resists the damage type that last hit you

pages.title: Boss & Path Synergy
pages.text: $(bold)Boss Ward$(): Less damage from boss entities$(br)$(bold)Steadfast$(): Knockback immunity$(br)$(bold)Nemesis$(): Tracks kills; bonus damage against bosses you have fought before$(br2)$(bold)Mana Temper$(): Your spells power up the weapon$(br)$(bold)RF Capacitance$(): Stored RF boosts damage$(br)$(bold)Convergence$(): A bonus when you wear tech and magic gear together

pages.title: Utility
pages.text: $(bold)Magnetism$(): Item pickup radius$(br)$(bold)Last Stand$(): Burst damage when you nearly die$(br)$(bold)Vitality$(): Max HP boost$(br)$(bold)Phalanx$(): Group defense aura$(br)$(bold)Quick Draw$(): Faster offhand swaps$(br2)$(bold)Next: $(l:icraft:systems/apotheosis_enchanting)Apotheosis Enchanting$(/l); better shelves give better rolls.$()

pages.title: Planet Enchants
pages.text: Each Ad Astra planet's mobs have a 12% chance to drop that planet's enchanted book:$(br2)$(bold)Lunar Stride$() (Moon): Reduces low-gravity movement penalties.$(br)$(bold)Thermal Regulation$() (Mars): Negates cold and heat environmental damage.$(br)$(bold)Pressure Shell$() (Venus): Reduces acid damage and pressure slowdown.

pages.title: Planet Enchants, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Void Adaptation$() (Glacio): Negates alien debuffs and mining fatigue.$(br)$(bold)Stellar Shield$() (Mercury): Solar radiation and fire resistance on planets.$(br2)$(bold)Collect these on early planets to survive later ones.$()
